What I did.

  1. Conducted thematic and sectoral research.
  2. Produced reports for the preparation of Country Economic Memorandums for Bangladesh and India.
  3. Conducted key informant interviews.

The assignment.

Assess opportunities for and constraints to trade and private sector-led growth; provide an integrated and long-run perspective of development priorities and identify reform areas that can foster inclusive growth, including recent developments in the context of the Covid-19 pandemic and LDC graduation.
